Join the Sharp HSNKL Half Marathon 2026 – A Celebration of Fitness, Family & Unity!

The Sharp HSNKL Half Marathon returns for its 4th thrilling edition in Kuala Lumpur! More than just a race, HSNKL is a RunCation experience – bringing together thousands of participants from across Malaysia and beyond. From big family groups to professional runners from ASEAN and other continents, everyone is welcome to be part of this vibrant celebration.

Expect a high-energy weekend filled with fun, fitness, and togetherness – all culminating in a massive flag-off at the iconic Dataran Merdeka.

Don’t miss out – run with us and be part of the movement!
